assets.title: Tech4TIME Logos for Branding & Advertisement
assets.lead: Four variants of the mark. Pick the one that matches the background it will sit on — the light-theme logo is dark ink for pale backgrounds, the dark-theme logo pale ink for dark ones.

items.title: Light Theme Logo
items.text: The primary mark, for placing on white or any pale background.
items.alt: Tech4TIME logo in dark ink on a transparent background

items.title: Dark Theme Logo
items.text: The same mark in pale ink, for placing on black or any dark background.
items.alt: Tech4TIME logo in pale ink on a transparent background

items.title: Light Theme With Background
items.text: The light mark supplied on its own pale plate, for use where a transparent file cannot be placed.

items.title: Dark Theme With Background
items.text: The dark mark supplied on its own dark plate, for use where a transparent file cannot be placed.
